steps.sql: SET SESSION sql_notes = 0
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS p0_collation_values
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS p0_collation_unique
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS p0_collation_storage
SET SESSION sql_notes = 1

CREATE TABLE p0_collation_values (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, ci VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NULL, KEY p0_collation_values_ci (ci)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE id IN (1, 15) ORDER BY id
SELECT CHARSET(ci) AS character_set_name, COLLATION(ci) AS collation_name FROM p0_collation_values WHERE id = 1
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci = 'cafe' ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci = 'é' ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci = 'strasse' ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci = 'i' ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE id <> 15 ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE id IN (12, 13, 14) ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT MIN(id) AS first_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ci ORDER BY first_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ci) AS distinct_count FROM p0_collation_values
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_values WHERE ci >= 'caf' AND ci < 'cag' ORDER BY ci, id
SELECT id, ci IS NULL AS is_null, ci = NULL AS equals_null FROM p0_collation_values ORDER BY ci IS NULL, ci, id

CREATE TABLE p0_collation_unique (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, ci VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY p0_collation_unique_ci (ci)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
INSERT INTO p0_collation_unique (id, ci) VALUES (1, 'café')
INSERT INTO p0_collation_unique (id, ci) VALUES (2, 'CAFE')
SELECT id, ci FROM p0_collation_unique ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE p0_collation_storage (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, fixed_ci CHAR(8) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL, varying_ci VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL, fixed_binary BINARY(8) NOT NULL, varying_binary VARBINARY(8) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
INSERT INTO p0_collation_storage (id, fixed_ci, varying_ci, fixed_binary, varying_binary) VALUES (1, 'a ', 'a ', 'a ', 'a '), (2, 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A')

SELECT id, fixed_ci, varying_ci, HEX(fixed_binary) AS fixed_binary_hex, HEX(varying_binary) AS varying_binary_hex, CHAR_LENGTH(fixed_ci) AS fixed_ci_length, CHAR_LENGTH(varying_ci) AS varying_ci_length FROM p0_collation_storage ORDER BY id
SELECT id, fixed_binary, varying_binary FROM p0_collation_storage ORDER BY id

SELECT id, fixed_ci = 'a' AS fixed_equals_a, varying_ci = 'a' AS varying_equals_a, fixed_binary = BINARY 'a' AS fixed_binary_equals_a, varying_binary = BINARY 'a' AS varying_binary_equals_a FROM p0_collation_storage ORDER BY id
SELECT id, varying_ci = 'a' AS ci_equals_a, varying_binary = BINARY 'a' AS binary_equals_a FROM p0_collation_storage ORDER BY id
DROP TABLE p0_collation_storage
DROP TABLE p0_collation_unique
DROP TABLE p0_collation_values
